thread.title: Dow's late-morning jump gets a more than 80-point fillip from McDonald's, Apple stocks - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow's late-morning jump gets a more than 80-point fillip from McDonald's, Apple stocks - MarketWatch
text:
Published: Apr 30, 2018 11:14 a.m. ET Share Mark DeCambre
The Dow Jones Industrial Average late-morning Monday was being buoyed by a pair of consumer-focused giants. Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.81% and McDonald's Corp. MCD, +5.03% were combining to contribute about 82 points to the Dow DJIA, -0.36% which was up about 140 points, or 0.6%, at 24,448. Better-than-expected profit and revenue for McDonald's in the first quarter helped to bolster the price-weighted average, while the market was anticipating iPhone maker's quarterly results after the close of trading on Tuesday. A $1 move in any one of the Dow's 30 components equates to a 6.89-swing in the price-weighted gauge. Elsewhere, the S&P 500 index SPX, -0.59% was up 0.3%, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.55% advanced by 0.4% at 7,147. Quote References
